summary: Tested new RoadLens auth + role-routing. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass — register (server ignores client-provided role), login, /auth/me, forgot-password (generic 202, no enumeration), reset-password 400 on invalid code, admin-only /api/admin/authority-users (200 create + login roundtrip; 404 invalid authority_id; 409 duplicate; 403 for USER; 401 without token), plus complaint lifecycle regression (AI-detected pothole allows complaint; clean-image inspection blocks complaint with 400). Frontend: unauthenticated screens (Login, Sign Up validation with signup-error, Forgot Password reset step with forgot-info, Google buttons) all work. BLOCKER: every authenticated flow crashes with ErrorBoundary 'Cannot use `href` and `tabBarButton` together' due to the Workspace tab in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx using both `href: user?.role === 'USER' ? null : undefined` and `tabBarButton`. Because of this, demo-user/demo-admin login landing, Workspace-tab visibility per role, Add-Authority modal, logout via profile menu, and persistent-session-after-reload could not be verified in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses both `href` (conditional null for USER) and `tabBarButton` on the same Tabs.Screen. Expo Router rejects this combo, so the entire tab shell crashes into ErrorBoundary after any successful login. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:86-98.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext successfully stores the token from /api/auth/demo-login and /api/auth/login, but rendering (tabs)/_layout.tsx immediately throws, so users never see Dashboard/Workspace. Blocks demo-user-btn, demo-admin-btn, open-create-authority-btn, profile-menu-btn -> logout-btn, and persistent-session-reload verifications.

react_native_issues.issue: `href` + `tabBarButton` combined on the workspace tab is invalid in current expo-router. To hide a tab conditionally, either (a) drop `tabBarButton` on that screen and keep `href: null` for USER, or (b) keep `tabBarButton` and instead make it render null for USER (return null from tabBarButton when role==='USER'), or (c) omit `<Tabs.Screen name="workspace"/>` entirely for USER role. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:86-98.

action_items: URGENT: Fix /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so Workspace tab does not combine `href` and `tabBarButton`. Recommended: remove `href` and render the tabBarButton to return null when user.role === 'USER'. This will unblock all authenticated UI flows.

After the tab-layout fix, re-run frontend tests covering: demo-user-btn -> Workspace tab hidden; demo-admin-btn -> Workspace tab visible and open-create-authority-btn opens the CreateAuthorityUserModal; profile-menu-btn -> logout-btn returns to Login; app reload keeps session (persistent login).
Consider removing legacy backend fallback defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET so misconfiguration fails fast (per environment contract).

Existing /app/backend/tests/test_roadlens_api.py still calls /api/auth/login with `username` field (old contract). Update or delete this file to keep regression suite green under the new email-based login schema.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public /api/auth/register correctly forces role=USER even if the client sends role=ADMIN (verified by test) — good security posture.
/api/auth/forgot-password always returns 202 with a single generic message regardless of whether the email exists — no account enumeration; verified.
/api/admin/authority-users is properly guarded by require_roles(ADMIN); USER gets 403 and unauthenticated gets 401; duplicate email 409 and unknown authority_id 404 all verified.
Workspace-tab role-hiding logic mixes two mutually-exclusive expo-router APIs, causing a runtime crash that defeats the client-side role protection entirely.

success_rate.frontend: Unauth screens 100% (Login/Signup/Forgot); authenticated flows 0% due to Tabs.Screen crash blocker

seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_-prefixed users (USER and AUTHORITY) via /api/auth/register and /api/admin/authority-users. No cleanup endpoint available; these remain in the users collection with the TEST_ prefix for traceability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth/admin/regression suite is green. After the (tabs)/_layout.tsx fix is applied, focus the next UI pass on: (1) demo-user-btn login -> confirm Workspace tab is NOT rendered while Dashboard/Inspect/Complaints/Alerts are; (2) demo-admin-btn login -> Workspace tab visible, open-create-authority-btn opens CreateAuthorityUserModal and its inputs render; (3) profile-menu-btn then logout-btn lands back on login-submit-button; (4) reload after login keeps the user in tabs (persistent session). Google buttons should only be checked for presence — do NOT complete OAuth. Reset-code path only validates the 400-invalid branch.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open the app, tap any of the demo login buttons (demo-user-btn/demo-authority-btn/demo-admin-btn), and the ErrorBoundary immediately renders 'Something went wrong / Cannot use `href` and `tabBarButton` together.' Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx sets `href: user?.role === 'USER' ? null : undefined` and simultaneously supplies a custom `tabBarButton` on the Workspace `Tabs.Screen`. Current expo-router treats these as mutually exclusive options and throws during tab tree resolution. Mitigation: keep `tabBarButton` and instead conditionally return null from it when role==='USER' (or drop `tabBarButton` on that screen if the tab-workspace testID is not required).
